feeds.title: Author Jan Moran Blog
feeds.description: Jan Moran is an 8-time USA Today and 2-time Wall Street Journal bestselling author of heartwarming fiction, including the feel-good, contemporary beach series Summer Beach, Coral Cottage, and Love California. Her riveting, immersive historical family sagas include Hepburn's Necklace, The Chocolatier, The Winemakers, and The Perfumer. St. Martin's Press, Goldmann/Penguin Random, and Newton Compton have published her novels, along with her imprint, Sunny Palms Press.

feeds.title: Darlene Deluca Blog
feeds.description: Darlene Deluca released her debut novel, 'Unexpected Legacy,' in January 2013. She writes heartfelt women's fiction and contemporary romance that feels real. She holds a degree in Journalism and has a vast store of writing material from parenting two children and working for twenty-plus years in Corporate America before turning to fiction writing. She reads a little bit of everything. She loves chocolate, tea, and books!

feeds.title: Jean M. Grant Blog
feeds.description: Jean M. Grant's blog posts range from personal journeys (travel, autism, parenting), to daydreaming, to craft blogs on the how-to's of writing and the publication process. Jean is an award-winning author of historical & contemporary romance and women's fiction.

feeds.title: Roma Cordon Blog
feeds.description: I've been an avid reader of romance novels for 30 years. I started with Mills & Boons and Harlequin novels in the 1980s. Why? Because real life is just too 'ordinary'. I'm a member of the Women's Fiction Writers Association and a PAN member of Romance Writers of America.

feeds.title: Jae Author Blog
feeds.description: This is the blog of Jae, an award-winning author of lesbian fiction. Blog posts about new and upcoming releases, writing tips, and book reviews exist. Jae is the author of twenty-three award-winning lesbian romances. When she's not writing, she is an avid reader of lesbian books, indulges her ice cream and stationery addictions, and watches way too many crime shows.

feeds.title: Laura Drake Blog
feeds.description: Laura has long wanted to make a foray into another genre she loves, Women's Fiction. The result was Days Made of Glass, the story of the first woman rodeo bullfighter.

feeds.description: I'm a digital nomad, creator and host of The Best of Women's Fiction interviews & podcast, part-time resident of the beautiful city of San Miguel de Allende in Mexico, avid instagramer, and full-time writer of women's fiction.

She writes books about characters who are flawed but who somehow still manage to overcome the challenges thrown in their paths and reach for happiness with their soul mates.

feeds.title: Maggie Smith Blog
feeds.description: Influenced by her former careers as a psychologist and a business owner, author Maggie Smith pens compelling stories of ordinary women who face extraordinary challenges with grit, brainpower, and strong doses of empathy and humor. She hosts the podcast Hear Us Roar and is managing editor of The Write City Magazine.

feeds.title: Women in Trouble Book Blog
feeds.description: I'm a voracious reader and lover of books who worked in publishing for 10+ years. In addition to reading, I sew, knit, attempt the occasional DIY project on Pinterest, and love to try new recipes. Most evenings find myself sitting on the couch, steps from my kitchen while something bakes or simmers with my head stuck in a book. I love any book that keeps me guessing. My husband once joked that I have a genre-women in trouble. So here we are.
